creation.musicLyricsGuide: Fɔ cogoya ni kumakan ɲɛfɔ i ka ɲinini la. Ka kumakanw bila tagamasiɲɛ kɔnɔ duguma. Ka {{instrumental}} bila ka kumakanw kɛ.
creation.setupAllDownload: Fanga ani ka fɛn bɛɛ labɛn cogoya yɛrɛyɛrɛ
creation.setupStorage: Fayiliw bɛ la: {{download}}. Rezerwa: {{reserve}}. Espaci faralen ka kan: {{required}}. Lafiyalen ka diski sugandilen kan: {{free}}.
creation.setupSpaceMissing: {{missing}} mankan. Ka yɔrɔ di walima ka disiki wɛrɛ sugandi ni a ka mara ye.
creation.setupTextNote: Sɛbɛnni dɔrɔn lo be se ka kɛ baro, sɛbɛnni, baarakɛminɛnw ani jaabi labɛnninw kama. A ladon: {{size}} koo la. A be hakilijagabɔfɛn caaman ɲini ka tɛmɛ {{defaultModel}} kan ani a tɛ jaaw wala lamɛnfɛnw baara a yɛrɛ la. Jaabi minw be fɔ, u be baara kɛ ni sisitɛmu kumakan ye. A sugandi sɛbɛri baaraw kama n’i hakili be se ka baara kɛ. Jaabi tiɲɛnninw sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni bɔyɔrɔw ye.
creation.setupImageNote: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Q4_K_M bɛ ɲɛnamaya dilan; Qwen3 bɛ ɲɛnamaya sɛbɛn ani VAE bɛ ɲɛnamaya laban dilan. Ka ɲɛnamaya kɛcogo, ɲɛnɛmaya, sigiju, dakunw ani ka ɲɛta bɔ. Dakun fɔlɔ: 21:9, dakun naani ani dakun kelen.
creation.setupMusicNote: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo bɛ donkolo minɛnw walima donkolow dilan. Planner bɛ kɛcɔgɔ dilan; 2B Q4_K_M bɔli kɛla bɛ sintezisi kɛ, sɛbɛni kodila bɛ ɲɛfɔliw minɛ ani VAE bɛ stereo 48 kHz kumakan dekodi. Ka waati hakɛ, kumakan kɛcɔgɔ, tempo, kumakanw, kaan, dakunw ani dakun. A ka kan: 30 segondi, dakun saba, WAV 24-bit ani dakun do.
creation.setupVideoNote: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B Q4_K_M bɛ kuluw dilan ka bɔ ɲɛfɔcogo dɔ la. A ka kan ka kɛ: sekondi duuru, 21:9 ani 16 FPS. A ka kan ka waati hakɛ, frame rate, rezolusyon, dakunw ani kisɛ labɛn. Dakun janw bɛ kuluw fara ɲɔgɔn kan; kuluw bɛ se ka don. · MP4: Python + imageio-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: A bɛ a ka modɛliw labaara ani ka u labɛn: LFM3-Omni + mmproj ka ɲɛsin sɛbɛni ma, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 ka ɲɛsin kan caman labaarali ma (CPU laada la), FLUX.2 Klein 4B ani a ka fenw ka ɲɛsin ɲɛnamaya laada ma, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×4, ACE-Step ka ɲɛsin fɔli ma (Instrumanw laada la), ani Wan2.1 ka ɲɛsin videyo ma. Ka ɲɛsin a ka fiyɛri bonya ma, diski kɛnɛ ma ani video ka laada ma. Ka ɲɛsin laada ma ni ka ɲɛsin ka laada ma bɛ sɔrɔ.
creation.videoDurationNote: Videyo janw bɛ faralen ɲɔgɔn kan ka bɔ yɔrɔw man janw na. Kɛnɛw bɛ se ka don ani u dilanni bɛ se ka waati jan taa.
creation.configure: Sankaba modɛli dɔ sugandi n’a ka API kilɛ ye, walima ka yɔrɔ ka motɛri sugandinin n’a ka dosiye wajibiyalenw labɛn Danni paramɛtiriw kɔnɔ.

Videwo be baara kɛ ni Difuzi ye. CPU/GPU sugandiliw be danfara ka bɔ ɲɔgɔn na encoder ni jaaw dilanbaga kama motɛriw kɔnɔ minw basiginin be fɛnw kan.

creation.ggufTextEncoder: Fɔlo dɔ ka kɔdikɛla (GGUF walima kompatibili Safetensors)
creation.ggufNote: Suguya diffusion modeli, masalabolo enkoderi ani VAE kelenkelenna. FLUX.2 Klein 4B kama, ka Qwen3-4B enkoderi labaara, ka a ka GGUF suguyaw fara kan. NVFP4 failiw lakanalen do o kɛlɛn ni Python ye ani PyTorch ka don ka farali ka cachi ba la; orijinalw bɛ to ka yɛlɛma. O bɛ diski kɛnɛ faralen kan ani RAM. Windows kan, Novera bɛ a la ani a bɛ motɛriman mara awtomatiki la. Auto bɛ baara kɛ ni fen min bɛ sɔrɔ ye; CUDA bɛ CUDA dilan. Distilled Klein bɛ baara kɛ ni 4 siraw ye ani CFG 1. Poids tɛ don.
creation.ggufWrongModel: Nin GGUF bɛ sɛbɛni kodɔnna dɔ ladon. A sugandili do kodɔnna kɛnɛ la ani ka difoni suguya wɛrɛ sugandili do ɲɛnamaya kɛnɛ la.
creation.nativeNote: Duguden NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Girinya lafiyamanw, Qwen3-4B GGUF kodɛri ani FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. A be Blackwell lo ɲininga (RTX 50 tugutugu ɲɔgɔn kɔ walima min be bɛn n’a ye), Pitɔn, CUDA PyTorch ani min tɛ se ka kɛ . NVFP4 dependanciw. Sɛbɛri-ka-ja dɔrɔn. Minɛn minw tɛ dɛmɛ, olu be dɛsɛ ka gwɛ; ka sugandi stable-diffusion.cpp walisa ka bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma. Ayi BF16 difuziyɔn kafe.
creation.deviceNote: Nin fɛn nunu bɛ ka u yɛrɛ ka fenw sugandi. Auto bɛ baara kɛ ni masini min bɛ sɔrɔ; native NVFP4 bɛ fɛ tuma bɛɛ ka GPU min bɛ se ka fara ɲɔgɔn kan ɲini ka dilan ani ka GPU sɛbɛni enkodiyɛri labaara ni VRAM bɛ sɔrɔ. Qwen kan CPU bɛ se ka VRAM mara n'ga enkodiyɛri ka dogo. Qwen kan GPU bɛ ka lagurunya labaara. In stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto bɛ baara kɛ ni motɛriman min sugandira ye; ka CUDA fanga di a kan ka CUDA dilan.
creation.totalTimeHint: Wati bɛ la a bɛ labaarali, masalabolo sariya, dilanni, ka se ka dabila, ka se ka dabila ani ka dabila. Labaarali dɔrɔn bɛ jira ka bɔ ɲɔgɔn na ni motɛriman bɛ a jira.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: GPU min bɛ bɔ, Qwen3-4B min bɛ kɔdikɛ CPU, 4 siraw kan, CFG 1. Ka sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni Windows ye ni Vulkan ye; telin ni bɛnkan bɛ bɔ a kan ka bɔ a ka minɛnw la.

creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: Fagan NVFP4 jatɛminɛw NVIDIA Blackwell GPU walima kokura min sɔrɔla ni 4.5 GiB VRAM ye. Ka baara kɛ ni jatɛminɛw ye Novera la, a ka kan ka modɛli dakun dafa fɔlɔ ka yɛlɛma ka kɛ NVFP4 GGUF ye min bɛ se ka baara kɛ ni a ye ani ka se ka jatɛminɛ. O yɛlɛmali ma se ka jatɛminɛ hali sisan nin sɛgɛsɛgɛli yɔrɔ la. Fisilɛri Safetensors min faralen do kan tɛ se ka dakɛɲɛ ka bɔ motɛriman datugulen na. Q8_0 bɛ to ka kɛ ka baara kɛli jatɛminɛ ye.
creation.setupOmniNote: A be sɔrɔ ɔridinatɛri ni telefɔni kan. Modɛli nɔgɔman sɛbɛninw, jaaw ani lamɛnfɛnw kama, ka baara kɛ ni {{projector}} file ye min wajibiyalen lo. Ladon: {{size}} koo la, o sɛbɛ fila bɛɛ kama. A sugandi ka ɲɛsin multimodali sigicogo nɔgɔman ma. Kanɲɛ cogoyaw be bɔ pilatifɔmu ni motɛri lo la. Kontɛkisi min ka jan, o be baara kɛ ni hakilimaya caaman ye.

instructions.textDefault: I ye Novera ye. Jaabi gwɛnin, tiɲɛn ani surun na baarakɛla ka kaan na. I ka tugu u ka dankariw kɔ, ka koo jɔnjɔnw sɛgɛsɛgɛ n’a be se ka kɛ ani ka sigasigaliw fɔ. Kana yɔrɔw, jaabiw wala kɛwale dafaninw labɛn abada.
instructions.imageDefault: K'a ɲini ka baarakɛcogo, cogoya, ani ka ɲɛda ta. Ka baara kɛ ni labɛni ye min ka ɲɛ, yelen min bɛ bɛn ani a ka ɲɛda fitini. K'a ɲini ka tagamasiɲɛw mara; ka distorsionw ani fɛn min tɛ ɲini ye bali. K'a sɛbɛnni fara a kan ni a ɲinilen do.
instructions.videoDefault: K'a ɲini ka baarakɛcogo, cogo ani wagati lasɛ. K'a ɲini ka baarakɛcogow, fɛn ani yelen ka kɛ kelen ye ka ɲɛsin a ka fotow ma. K'a ɲini ka baarakɛcogo ɲumanba ni ka baarakɛyɔrɔ ka kamera mara. K'a ɲini ka baarakɛcogo juguman, distortion ani sɛbɛni min ma ɲini.
